aThe unit system is a convenient way of quantifying consumption of ethanol and offers a suitable
means to give practical guidance. However, there are several problems with the unit system. The
ethanol content of various brands of alcoholic beverages varies considerably (for example, the
ethanol content of beers/ales is in the range 0.5–9.0% so a pint may contain 2–5 units) and the
amounts of alcohol consumed in homes bear little in common with standard measures.
